section.title: Commit messages
section.simpara: The title line must not exceed 72 characters including the newline. All other lines must not exceed 80 characters including the newline. Every commit message has exactly one -- line describing the state before, one => line describing the state after, and at most one * line for optional additional information:
section.programlisting: Factorise reusable snippets from the vision document -- Other documents will have the same author, publisher, or introduction. => Extracted shareable fragments for reuse via XInclude. * Enhanced phrasing along the way. [Product: User Story 9]
